【Lock app in Recent Apps (Recommended)】
Open the multitasking/recent apps screen, long press or tap the lock icon on the Element X card. When locked, clearing all background apps will not kill Element X.

【Accessibility Keep-Alive Service】
When enabled in System Accessibility settings, Android's system_server automatically guards this service. Even if the process is swiped away from recent tasks or killed by the system, Android will automatically respawn the push service within 1 second.
(Note: This service is only used for push persistence and does not collect or inspect any screen content or personal data).
